# Known finding-set diffs between guff and golangci-lint (R21).
# Format: <target> <guff-only|golangci-only> <normalized-key>
# normalized-key = relpath:line:linter:message
# Regenerated by: ./compat/run.sh --update-allowlist
#
# Prefer fixing guff over growing this list. Entries here are accepted
# mismatches (message phrasing, enable-set gaps, known DEFERRED).
#
# WARNING: `--update-allowlist` rewrites this file from the current diff and
# drops the comments below. The rationale for every entry is kept in
# docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §5, which is the copy to read and to update.
#
# Keys are pinned to syncthing v2.1.3 (corpus/hunt.json), so the line numbers
# are stable until that ref moves.
#
# canonicalheader x2 — upstream's answer for this package is a **coin flip**,
# not a decision guff can match.
#
# lasiar/canonicalheader v1.1.2 opens by scanning `pass.TypesInfo.Uses` for any
# `net/http` object named `Header`, keeping whichever one the **map** iteration
# hands it first, and then requires
# `types.Identical(recv, headerObject.Type())` at every call site. `net/http`
# has four objects with that name: the type `Header`, the fields
# `Request.Header` and `Response.Header` — whose type *is* `http.Header` — and
# the method `ResponseWriter.Header`, whose type is `func() Header`. When the
# loop lands on the method the identity test never holds and the whole package
# reports nothing.
#
# syncthing's `lib/api` uses both forms: `api.go:616` writes
# `w.Header().Set("X-Syncthing-ID", …)` and `api_csrf.go:99` reads
# `r.Header.Get("X-API-Key")`. So the package has two candidates and the result
# is decided by map order.
#
# Measured 2026-09-05 (docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §4, 続き 180). With a fresh
# golangci-lint cache each run — which `compat/run.sh` gives every confirmation
# attempt — a three-package scratch module returns 0 or 2 at random for the
# mixed shape, always 0 for method-only, always 1 for field-only. Three
# consecutive `./compat/hunt.sh --name syncthing` runs returned golangci=656,
# 654, 656.
#
# guff now matches both deterministic halves (see
# `canonicalheader::package_has_header_typed_object`) and takes the *reporting*
# side of the coin flip, which is why these two are guff-only whenever upstream
# lands on the method.
syncthing guff-only lib/api/api.go:616:canonicalheader:non-canonical header "X-Syncthing-ID", instead use: "X-Syncthing-Id"
syncthing guff-only lib/api/api_csrf.go:99:canonicalheader:non-canonical header "X-API-Key", instead use: "X-Api-Key"
